review_evidence: README identifies Leansec as a port of the Agdarsec total parser-combinator library rather than a command-line application or project wrapper.

Leansec/Basic.lean defines Success with a proof field small : size < n and Parser.run indexed by input size, so successful partial parses carry a checked strictly-smaller-leftovers invariant in their type.

Leansec/Induction.lean defines Box, fixb, fix, loeb and size-decreasing transition operators for well-founded indexed recursion; Leansec/Examples/Arithmetic.lean contains checked parser-membership examples. These dependent interfaces are reusable formal prior art even though Lexer.lessTokens is presently axiomatized.
summary: Retain leansec: its total parser-combinator design exposes dependent interfaces carrying consumption/size invariants, well-founded recursion machinery, and formal parser examples.
